scripts._comment_build: Cloudflare does NOT run this file's scripts. Its build command is set in the Cloudflare Pages dashboard and runs generate_sitemap.py only. Verified 2026-09-13: the live blog index matches the committed file, so generate_blog_index.py has never run in production.
scripts._comment_blog_index: DO NOT RUN generate_blog_index.py. It rewrites blog/index.html and strips data-tag from every card, breaking the category filter pills. Confirmed 2026-09-13: it cut data-tag from 33 to 8 (BM) and 58 to 11 (MC). Add new cards by hand, matching the live markup including data-tag, until the generator is fixed.
scripts.build: python3 generate_sitemap.py --domain https://medicare-california.com --dir . && python3 site-check.py --dir . --domain https://medicare-california.com --report
scripts.UNSAFE:blog-index: echo 'Refusing: this generator strips data-tag and breaks the blog filters. See _comment_blog_index.' && exit 1
